import builtins

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print one log line in the form ``[level] message`` to stdout.

    Writes only to standard output. Never touches the file system.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_formats_level_and_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "server started")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] server started\n"


def test_log_line_prints_exactly_one_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "disk nearly full")
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert out.count("\n") == 1
    assert out.endswith("\n")


def test_log_line_preserves_message_text(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "failed: code=42 [retry]")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] failed: code=42 [retry]\n"


def test_log_line_allows_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_does_not_open_files(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    def _forbidden_open(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", _forbidden_open)
    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"
